result_summary.title: Slow response times suspected in KPI Tracker (EU-Central)
result_summary.description: Users in the EU-Central production environment are reporting slow performance. We suspect the issue lies with the KPI Tracker module, as pages containing these widgets are taking significantly longer to load than usual. This affects approximately 58 users and has a moderate impact on daily operations. We are seeing timeouts on requests that typically complete in sub-seconds.
